facts.text: FSV3030Sp is the spectrum-mode class of the FSV3030 driver family and derives from FSV3030Base
The FSV3030 constructor opens the instrument through BaseInstrument and sends SYST:DISP:UPD ON
BaseInstrument writes *CLS and then queries *IDN? while it connects
The center frequency is written as 'SENSE:FREQ:CENT <value><unit>'
The span is written as 'FREQ:SPAN <value><unit>' and the full span as 'SENS:FREQ:SPAN:FULL'
set_mark_freq accepts marker numbers 1 to 7 and writes 'CALC:MARK<x>:X <Hz value>' after converting the caller's unit to Hz
query_marker_x reads 'CALC:MARK<x>:X?' and divides the reply by the requested unit, so the reply is in Hz
query_marker_y reads 'CALC:MARK<x>:Y?' and returns the reply as a float
set_abort_meas writes 'ABOR' to abort the current measurement
The clone's FSV3030 simulator identifies the instrument as 'Rohde&Schwarz,FSV3030,100001,3.40'
The clone's FSV3030 simulator answers FREQ:CENT?
The clone's FSV3030 simulator answers CALC:MARK1:X?, CALC:MARK1:Y?, CALC:DELT1:X? and CALC:DELT1:Y?
